batch_scope_name_events.source_text_ja: もう1話分ネームが上がり、

progress_coordinate.page_log: 0.01 per observed manuscript page, capped at 0.19
progress_coordinate.note: Status flags are retained separately; the coordinate is furthest observed progress, not a claim of irreversible sequential work.

all_pairs_coordinate_likelihood.delta_c: target publication coordinate minus event coordinate
all_pairs_coordinate_likelihood.note: All coordinate pairs inform each historical batch component; components, not pairs, are averaged.

no_start_update: The posterior support is conditioned through each issue publicly known not to contain the batch. The analog-fade likelihood is held at the latest production-event issue until a record hiatus.

next_batch.evidence: Parametric Level 1 gap prior convolved with the direct predecessor posterior. Following-batch production events are not reused here.

correlation_note: Each analog contributes ONE likelihood factor. The per-chapter readiness states summarise correlated tweets; treating every event as independent would badly over-sharpen the posterior. Same-batch readiness has weight 0.75; preceding-batch production context has weight 0.25. Analog fade is frozen between production events until a record hiatus.
